meta.title: Add GPU-accelerated Smith-Waterman module
meta.body_summary: Add optional GPU-accelerated Smith-Waterman alignment using PyOpenCL, with Java CLI integration, documentation, and unit tests.

perf_labels.notes: Author self‑merged new GPU module with tests and docs in under 4 minutes, no human review; no performance evidence beyond narrative claim.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 384 changed lines across 9 files, this is a moderate-sized addition by absolute volume. The change introduces a new GPU‑accelerated module with documentation and tests, consistent with a feature PR that was self‑merged quickly without review.

review_details.concern_detail: No substantive human review; only bot formatting (DeepSource autofix) and a CLA check occurred.
review_details.performance_claim: GPU‑accelerated Smith‑Waterman alignment reduces computation time compared to CPU implementation.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Adding GPU support via PyOpenCL requires correct OpenCL kernel and cross‑language integration; the PR merged without review, suggesting the maintainer trusts the generated code or considers the change low‑risk.

detection_detail.code_reading: No evidence of code reading review in dataset.
detection_detail.ci_auto: DeepSource bot automatically applied code formatting via a second commit.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: Unit tests exercising CPU fallback are present, but no benchmark or profiling data is provided to verify GPU speedup.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: New feature addition; no regressions reported or handled.

core_change_summary.description: Adds Python module `gpu_smith_waterman.py` with OpenCL kernel for GPU‑accelerated Smith‑Waterman alignment, a Java wrapper `SmithWatermanAligner` that invokes the Python script, CLI integration in `CmdArgs`, unit tests, and documentation.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Documentation and tests provide observability but no runtime performance metrics.

DeepSource bot automatically applies style formatting (Autopep8, Google Java Format).
